verses.text: I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

segments.text: I will extol thee, my God, O King;
And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

verses.text: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

segments.text: Every day will I bless thee;
And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

verses.text: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.

segments.text: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised;
And his greatness is unsearchable.

verses.text: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.

segments.text: One generation shall laud thy works to another,
And shall declare thy mighty acts.

verses.text: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.

segments.text: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor,
And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.

verses.text: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.

segments.text: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts;
And I will declare thy greatness.

verses.text: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.

segments.text: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness,
And shall sing of thy righteousness.

verses.text: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.

segments.text: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful;
Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.

verses.text: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.

segments.text: Jehovah is good to all;
And his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.text: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.

segments.text: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah;
And thy saints shall bless thee.

verses.text: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;

segments.text: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom,
And talk of thy power;

verses.text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

segments.text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts,
And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

verses.text: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

segments.text: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,
And thy dominion
endureth
throughout all generations.

verses.text: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.

segments.text: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall,
And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.

verses.text: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.

segments.text: The eyes of all wait for thee;
And thou givest them their food in due season.

verses.text: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

segments.text: Thou openest thy hand,
And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

verses.text: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.

segments.text: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways,
And gracious in all his works.

verses.text: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.

segments.text: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him,
To all that call upon him in truth.

verses.text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.

segments.text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him;
He also will hear their cry and will save them.

verses.text: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.

segments.text: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him;
But all the wicked will he destroy.

verses.text: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

segments.text: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah;
And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

headings.text: A Psalm of praise; of David.
